findings.problem: The many branch adds de before the elliptical participle gardés (e.g. 1 000 000 de gardés). The count is understandable, but this clipped label reads more naturally without de; de is appropriate before an explicit noun such as terminaux, not necessary in this bare retained-count fragment. This is rare-branch copy polish, not a scope or numeric-semantics error.
